explanation: Three bugs were present: (1) The slice used `i-window` to `i` (exclusive of current element), but a trailing window should include the current element, so it should be `i-window+1` to `i+1`. (2) Division was always by `window` instead of the actual number of elements in the window slice, causing wrong results when fewer than `window` elements are available. (3) There was no check for `min_periods`: positions with fewer than `min_periods` values should return null (None) instead of a mean. (4) No validation of `1 <= min_periods <= window` was performed.
